tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Avigayil: avi, 'my father', + gil, 'joy'. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-b-y-g-y-l. Abigail, wife of David (1 Samuel 25). Abigail is a Hebrew name meaning “My father is joy”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
